source: Toprank Review Academy (TRA) Nursing Module – Complete Handout

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: A guideline allowing only one choice of action, fairly inflexible, is a:
questions.rationale: Rules allow one action; policies are broad guidelines; procedures give step sequences.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Planning (PDF p. 511)
questions.quote: Describe situations that allow only one choice of action.

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Daily and weekly unit plans made by head nurses are:
questions.rationale: Operational: daily/weekly, head nurses; intermediate: 6 months–2 years, supervisors.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Operational Planning (PDF p. 511)
questions.quote: Daily and weeklyplans for administration or direct patient care.

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Purchase of a new CT scanner belongs in which budget?
questions.rationale: Capital budget covers major equipment and fixed assets.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Budgeting (PDF p. 511)
questions.quote: E.g. MRI, X-ray, CT scan

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Which budget forces managers to justify every expense from scratch?
questions.rationale: Zero-based budgeting sets priorities and justifies costs; it is time-consuming.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Budgeting (PDF p. 512)
questions.quote: forces managers to set priorities and justify

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: The principle that each employee reports to only one superior is:
questions.rationale: Unity of command: one superior; span of control: number reporting to a manager.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Principles of Organizing (PDF p. 512)
questions.quote: There can only be one superior

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: The number of people reporting directly to a manager is the:
questions.rationale: Span of control.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Principles of Organizing (PDF p. 512)
questions.quote: The number of people that reports directly to a manager

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: An advisory department with no authority to implement its recommendations is a:
questions.rationale: Staff positions are advisory (training, research); line has direct authority.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Types of Organization (PDF p. 512)
questions.quote: It is purely advisory to the line structure

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Which scheduling repeats a set pattern over a number of weeks?
questions.rationale: Cyclical scheduling is fair, saves time, and lets staff plan ahead.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Types of Scheduling (PDF p. 513)
questions.quote: Covers a designated number of weeks as one cycle, which is repeated thereon.

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Under DOH staffing standards, how many relievers factor is used for staff working 40 hours/week?
questions.rationale: Multiply needed personnel by 0.15 (40 h/week) or 0.12 (48 h/week).
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Staffing Formula (PDF p. 514)
questions.quote: Multiply the number of nursing personnel needed by 0.15

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Per the DOH distribution of nursing staff per shift, the AM shift receives:
questions.rationale: AM 45%, PM 37%, Night 18%.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Distribution Per Shift (PDF p. 515)

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: An incident report submitted to the nursing director is which line of communication?
questions.rationale: Upward: subordinate to superior (incident and grievance reports).
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Lines of Communication (PDF p. 515)
questions.quote: Incident report

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Shift endorsement between staff nurses is which communication line?
questions.rationale: Horizontal communication occurs between peers at the same level.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Lines of Communication (PDF p. 515)
questions.quote: Endorsements

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Which task should a head nurse not delegate?
questions.rationale: Evaluation and disciplinary action, overall accountability, and signing authority are not delegated.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Delegation (PDF p. 516)
questions.quote: Evaluating the staff and/or taking necessary corrective or disciplinary action

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: One nurse gives all medications and another does all treatments. This is:
questions.rationale: Functional nursing is task-oriented and fragments care.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Functional Nursing (PDF p. 516)
questions.quote: This kind of nursing modality is task- oriented

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: An RN responsible 24 hours a day for 4–6 patients from admission to discharge practices:
questions.rationale: Primary nursing assures continuity and trust.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Primary Nursing (PDF p. 517)
questions.quote: RN remains responsible for the care of those patients 24 hours per day.

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: A private duty nurse caring for one patient uses which method?
questions.rationale: Case method is one-to-one (ICU, private duty).
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Case Method (PDF p. 517)
questions.quote: E.g. ICU nurse, private duty nurse

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Planned activities that introduce new employees to the work environment are:
questions.rationale: Orientation is for new employees; in-service improves current job performance.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Staff Development (PDF p. 517)
questions.quote: Done for new employees

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Which conflict resolution strategy produces a win-win outcome?
questions.rationale: Collaboration has both parties work together to solve the problem.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Conflict Resolution (PDF p. 518)
questions.quote: Collaboration Both work out days to solve the problem Win-win

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Conflict between the nursing and dietary departments is:
questions.rationale: Intergroup conflict is between two groups.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Types of Conflict (PDF p. 518)
questions.quote: Conflict between two groups of people in the organization

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: What is the first step in the control process?
questions.rationale: Set standards, measure, compare, reinforce, correct.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Controlling (PDF p. 518)
questions.quote: Establish Standard

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: A performance appraisal tool describing specific observed incidents of a nurse's work is:
questions.rationale: Anecdotal records describe observed experiences and behaviors.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Performance Appraisal (PDF p. 518)
questions.quote: Describes the nurse's experience with a group or a person

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Evaluating whether the nursing process steps were followed is which quality criterion?
questions.rationale: Structure: setting; process: steps of care; outcome: results in client.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Quality Assurance (PDF p. 519)
questions.quote: Steps in nursing process

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Continuously comparing a unit's performance against the best is:
questions.rationale: Benchmarking measures what exists against the best.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Benchmarking (PDF p. 519)
questions.quote: A continuous process of measuring what exist against the best
